effect: Holding the glass brought the systems together: muscles still use ATP, signals adjust their pulls, and blood continues delivering supplies even while the arm is still.
reaction: The reminder that stillness requires ongoing work was a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting and holding the glass was most worthwhile because it showed how muscle work, control and supply contribute to one familiar action.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two skin layers was predictable after building each one, although it clarified their different jobs.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that living cells deeper in the skin continually replace the dead outer cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the offered combinations generally had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would be curious to try another chapter if it used the assembled body in another familiar action, though the predictable combinations make me less eager to continue indefinitely.
